content: Calibre official plugin docs (manual.calibre-ebook.com/creating_plugins.html): InterfaceAction plugins split metadata (InterfaceActionBase, actual_plugin as an import-path string) from GUI logic (separate ui.py) so CLI tools skip GUI libs; genesis() wires the QAction once; action_spec=(name, shortcut, tooltip, default_keys); is_customizable/config_widget/save_settings is the three-method settings contract; JSONConfig('plugins/<unique_name>') is the recommended settings store; get_resources/get_icons read from the plugin zip; multi-file plugins need plugin-import-name-<name>.txt at zip root. Docs page did not cover ThreadedJob/JobManager specifics.
